$duplicateCheck: The xlsm rate file is byte-identical (md5-confirmed) between the 2026 and 2027 folders — one extraction covers both.
$anomaly: [Unverified / Flag] The xlsm file is named 'RATES 2026' but its own internal labels are inconsistent: the 'NON RESIDENT' rates tab header reads 'MT KENYA 2025 OUTFITTING SERVICES' / 'VERSION 2025.1', while the workbook's 'Front Page' tab reads 'VERSION 2023.1' and contains a broken external-workbook cell reference ('...2025.3 2026(2) (2).xls]Front Page'!E25'), suggesting this file was assembled/rolled-forward from older versions without every internal label being updated. Filename says 2026, content says 2025/2023 in different places. Treat the numeric rates as the current best-available figures (they are the newest file present) but do not cite an internal 'version number' from this file as authoritative.
$anomaly2: [Unverified / Flag] A separate document in the same folder ('Specifications+Pack+2019...docx') refers to the outfitter as 'Summits Africa' rather than 'African Ascents', even though the itinerary info-pack docx files (Chogoria, Timau) carry African Ascents' own letterhead/contact details. Not resolved which name is current/correct — possible rebrand or template reuse. Contact details used throughout (info@africanascents.com, Nanyuki) point to African Ascents as the operating entity.

nonResidentRates.note: Per-person USD rates by group size (1 to 8+ pax) for VIP / LUXURY / STANDARD service specifications, at RACK / TOUR OPERATOR (offshore, 20% off rack) / PARTNER (local, 30% off rack) commercial tiers.
nonResidentRates.pricingPolicy: 'Local partners 30%, offshore tour operators 20%' off RACK — stated directly in source.

tourOperatorOffshore20pctOffRack.note: Figures are RACK x 0.80, confirmed arithmetically consistent with the stated '20% off RACK' policy.

partnerLocal30pctOffRack.note: Figures are RACK x 0.70, confirmed arithmetically consistent with the stated '30% off RACK' policy. This is the tier Sunworld (a Kenyan/local operator) would likely book at, but confirm with African Ascents which tier applies to Sunworld specifically.

citizenResidentRates.note: East Africa Citizen/Resident tier (separate from Non-Resident above). Included for completeness though outside this project's usual Non-Resident scope.

rack.confidenceNote: LUXURY and STANDARD citizen/resident tiers also present in source but omitted here for brevity — re-open the xlsm 'CITIZEN-RESIDENT RATES' sheet if a citizen-tier LUXURY/STANDARD quote is needed.
